text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Triple Tiara behind us, Mejiro
Dober
and I have to decide on our next
race...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she wants to create a new Mejiro
legacy, then
there's one race that would
be the perfect
send-off to her classic
year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer? What do you think I
should run in
next?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: Let's enter the Arima Kinen, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This race will be an invaluable
experience for her.
She'll be able to see
firsthand what races in her

fast-approaching senior year will be like.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, compared to the races she's
run so far,
it won't be easy. Not only is it
a longer race, but
the competition will
be on a different level.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, I want to take this huge challenge
head-on
with all of our strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm sure she'll also be racing in the Arima Kinen too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's right. It's guaranteed that Air
Groove, the
Empress, will run in the
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And no doubt she'll be Mejiro Dober's
greatest
threat and rival on the
racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No... You've got it backwards.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no. Sorry, I didn't get all quiet
because I
don't want to run in it. It's the
opposite, actually.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm just so happy. I'm finally going to
race against
Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We'll have to start preparing for the
Arima Kinen
right away. I'll need to
improve my stamina as well
as a few
other areas I'm worried about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Let's start training today! I'm already
excited
thinking about it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober doesn't look discouraged
in the
slightest! In fact, it looks like my
suggestion lit a
fire under her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she'll do great. And to prepare
her for
success, we get right to training
for the Arima
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day at the Mejiro estate...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Dober, Dober! Big news!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what's wrong, Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's the Arima Kinen! Have you looked at
the
pre-race popularity poll results?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, the results came out today. But
no, I
haven't looked at them yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: W-wait a second... Is this real?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You came in third out of all the other
prominent
racers in the lineup! That's
astounding, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
This level of popularity is really
something,
especially since you're still in
your classic year!
Congrats, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Race with your head held high, Dober.
We are all
looking forward to your grand
performance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Go out there and stir up the crowd into
a real
frenzy, all right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Be sure to show Nakayama who you are
in this
moment. If you can manage that,
your tale will be
passed down through
the generations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping to run in the Arima Kinen
with you,
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I suppose there's always next year. I'm
sure that
race will be a story for the
ages!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: So for now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Do your best and run a race you won't
regret,
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I will!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Air Groove got first in the popularity
poll... No
surprise there!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(As part of my Mejiro legacy, I'm going
to show
everyone a performance to
remember at the
Arima Kinen!)
